title: Service Goodwill Allowances by Marlowe Rewards Tier
content:
Marlowe Rewards sets two goodwill-point allowances for each tier. The per-case allowance is the points granted for one documented delivery service failure, before the annual allowance is applied. The annual allowance is the most goodwill points one membership can be granted in a calendar year.

| Tier | Per-case goodwill allowance (points) | Annual goodwill allowance per membership (points per calendar year) |
|---|---|---|
| Marlowe Rewards Member | 250 | 750 |
| Marlowe Rewards Silver | 300 | 900 |
| Marlowe Rewards Gold | 400 | 1200 |
| Marlowe Rewards Platinum | 500 | 1500 |
| Marlowe Rewards Icon | 750 | 2250 |
| Marlowe Rewards Atelier | 1000 | 3000 |

## Notes

- At every tier, the annual allowance is three times the per-case allowance.
- The allowances are counted in whole points.
